reasons.message: Model selection ran without separated calibration and test folds.
Candidates were scored on 1 selection fold — too few to rank them, so the strongest baseline (last_value) was published and the candidate scores are evidence, not a ranking.

Degraded forecast: model selection used a single trailing 3-observation holdout; rolling-origin calibration and final testing were unavailable. At least 20 observations (have 18) are needed for separated selection and calibration.

Selection under-powered: a single trailing holdout cannot rank incremental candidates. The admitted robust baseline (last_value) is published; candidate scores are reported as evidence, not a ranking.
